detail: Validated model implementation must be present.
Frozen Step 33 output must be present.
Frozen Step 34 output must be present.
match_id is defined as unique fcode.
Frozen processing sequence must be one-to-one.
Strict classification is one row per player.
Cohorts are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.
One strict prematch diagnostic per player.
Step 33 is one row per test match.
Step 33 must contain only the held-out year.
Each match has one A and one B focal row.
Matches with exactly one debuting player.
Full-history, Step 33, and Step 34 processing positions.
Held-out first appearances are not model-start rows.
Missing dates are retained; date-based active scales are unavailable for affected rows.
Unavailable values are expected at the beginning of 1985 before any player is established.
The secondary date-based scale can be unavailable for missing dates or an empty active pool.
Small annual cohorts should not be overinterpreted.
Material convention differences are reported as sensitivity evidence and do not replace the current convention.
Any mismatch is saved separately and does not silently replace Step 41.
Every requested Step 42 CSV output exists.
